config.label: Figma personal access token (read-only)
config.description: Figma personal access token (read-only). Only needed for the REST path — not required when the Plumb plugin is paired in Figma desktop. Create one at figma.com → Settings → Security → Personal access tokens.

config.label: Optional label shown in the Plumb Figma plugin when multiple plumb-mcp servers are paired with the same plugin (multi-agent connect)
config.description: Optional label shown in the Plumb Figma plugin when multiple plumb-mcp servers are paired with the same plugin (multi-agent connect). Defaults to the basename of the current working directory.
